svg.title: Functional score and generated-test mutation sensitivity
svg.desc: Functional scores for all six tasks, plus two separately interpreted generated-test sensitivity panels. Mutation pair means require two usable repetitions; incomplete pairs show N/A and their actual usable coverage. N/A is not zero.
svg.text: Functional scores are near the ceiling; tests show more variation
Two repetitions per cell · scores in % · mutation pair means require 2/2 usable evaluations
Main score grades the saved code. It is separate from accepted delivery: the Sol 6 Max service timed out with a passing snapshot.
Mutation panels measure sensitivity to fixed seeded defects, not overall code quality; their detection rules differ (see scoring.md).
Mutation pair means require 2/2 usable completed candidates. No added tests = 0; invalid, inconclusive, or incomplete pairs = N/A.
The complex optimizer panel has substantial missing coverage, including positive-control timeouts. Compare coverage before comparing scores.
Manual maintainability / design review remains pending. No overall quality score or general intelligence ranking is claimed.
